description: This file implements a sentence embedding service using the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model for semantic similarity tasks, including model loading, embedding generation, and similarity computations.

classes.name: EmbeddingService
classes.description: A class providing methods for generating sentence embeddings and computing similarities.

methods.name: _get_model
methods.description: Lazy load and return the sentence embedding model.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Property to access the model, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Generate embeddings for a single text or list of texts.

methods.name: similarity
methods.description: Compute cosine similarity between two texts.

methods.name: batch_similarity
methods.description: Compute similarity scores between a query and multiple candidate texts.

methods.name: find_most_similar
methods.description: Find the most similar candidate texts to a query based on similarity scores.
